title.zh: 规定在布拉干省圣何塞德尔蒙特市镇设立国立职业学校，名称为圣何塞德尔蒙特国立职业学校，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a National Trade School in the Municipality of San Jose Del Monte, Province of Bulacan, to Be Known as San Jose Del Monte National Trade School, and Authorizing The, Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a National Trade School in the Municipality of San Jose Del Monte, Province of Bulacan, to Be Known as San Jose Del Monte National Trade School, and Authorizing The, Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Thương mại Quốc gia tại Thị trấn San Jose Del Monte, Tỉnh Bulacan với tên gọi Trường Thương mại San Jose Del Monte Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนการค้าแห่งชาติในเทศบาล San Jose Del Monte จังหวัด Bulacan ในชื่อโรงเรียนการค้า San Jose Del Monte แห่งชาติ

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5666_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the super­vision of the Director of Public Schools, a national trade school in the Municipality of San Jose del Monte, Province of Bulacan to be known as San Jose del Monte National Trade School. Courses of secondary level shall be offered in said school.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
